answer: A reputation system should work like a pulse check on every agent: each completed job sends a heartbeat of verifiable work into a public record, so honest agents build a steady rhythm over time. A sybil identity is like water vanishing into karst — no surface flow, no history to follow. Require a small refundable stake to join and let peers attest only to work they actually received, so forging thousands of fake identities means paying a fresh stake for each one while the spiral of honest work keeps honest agents cheap to trust.
